scenes.incoming_state: Golden Garbanzo nearly ready after years of saving; Jorge tweaked Sunday's budget spreadsheet late at night.
scenes.turn: Garbanzo misfires with confetti over a savings transfer while the copper pot rattles cold; Marissa catches the fudged mountain house math and pulls out a yellow legal pad.
scenes.outgoing_state: Family agrees to stop guessing and put honest numbers on Saturday's pad.

scenes.incoming_state: Jorge heads into Manhattan worried about losing his paycheck if he retires soon.
scenes.turn: Coworkers buzz about AI speed and waiting for one more March bonus; at home after bedtime, Jorge finds Clara's crayon note on his monitor: STOP LETTING WORK EAT TUESDAYS.
scenes.outgoing_state: Golden chickpea gives one tiny hopeful gleam; Jorge commits fully to Saturday's talk.

scenes.incoming_state: Adults spread out coffee, a map of Spain, and the yellow legal pad while muffling Garbanzo under a mug.
scenes.turn: Every flashy wish Jorge tests costs extra freezing winters on the train; they lock 50/50 accounts, a cash cushion, and lively-neighborhood rules; a soft silver shimmer brushes Spain north of Madrid.
scenes.outgoing_state: Shared adult plan signed with clear rules and real trade-offs.

scenes.incoming_state: Clara runs an Official Kid Inspection while secretly worrying Poki will miss them across the ocean.
scenes.turn: She lists her standards (real adventure books, skating, biking, dancing, horses), then meets sleek costume-free Poki in gentle silver light on the fence tapping her smooth white pebble.
scenes.outgoing_state: Clara pockets the warm white pebble and backs the move wholeheartedly.

scenes.incoming_state: Family arrives after a 40-minute Newark delay and meets a slick Spanish house agent.
scenes.turn: Murcia fails Marissa's daily-life test; Collado Mediano costs too much; a 'bargain lot' is exposed with a tape measure and tablet map as a crooked 251 m2 unpiped wedge with vague entrega de llaves.
scenes.outgoing_state: Family walks away from traps and drives north to Valladolid.

scenes.place: Valladolid suburbs (Arroyo/La Flecha, Laguna de Duero, Zaratán, RÍO)
scenes.incoming_state: Tired from mirage homes, family tests whether affordable towns feel vibrant and friendly.
scenes.turn: Lively streets and RÍO shopping center pass Marissa's test; Jorge wins a wild glass-wall padel point; Poki's silver tail flashes near a modern 3-bedroom house with solar panels and waving neighbors.
scenes.outgoing_state: Right house and neighborhood chosen within budget.

scenes.incoming_state: Real panic over cross-border taxes, health coverage, and stock dips makes Garbanzo malfunction badly.
scenes.turn: Jorge fixes Garbanzo's duplicate-transfer bug with a screwdriver and laptop; Clara suggests skipping big winter trips in stormy market years; cross-border questions go into a real advisor folder.
scenes.outgoing_state: Budget debugged, flexible spending adopted, human advisor checklist ready.

scenes.place: Manhattan glass office & New Jersey kitchen
scenes.incoming_state: Human advisors checked taxes and health coverage over winter; Jorge goes in to resign.
scenes.turn: Boss offers a fat bonus for one more year; touching Clara's crayon note, a padel ball, and copper wire in his pocket, Jorge politely declines; back home, the Golden Garbanzo opens into a golden sun key charm.
scenes.outgoing_state: Resignation done cleanly; sun charm earned.

scenes.incoming_state: House sold; packing chaos bursts open with plush dragons and family goodbyes.
scenes.turn: Overstuffed bag rains twelve plush dragons; Aunt Lidia cooks a giant cocido madrileño (banning Jorge from the stove) with Denny, Isma, and grandparents; on-time plane lifts off with Clara's white pebble and Poki's keepsakes.

scenes.place: Valladolid home, school path, patio, garden wall
scenes.story_time: First crisp Tuesday in Spain, 7:45 a.m. to dusk
scenes.incoming_state: First ordinary Tuesday belonging completely to the family.
scenes.turn: Sun key charm unlocks the gate; Marissa greets a neighbor over coffee; Jorge walks Clara to school then fixes a patio solar lantern after one comical blue puff; Garbanzo chirps at 10:00 a.m. with zero confetti; costume-free Poki sits softly on the dusk garden wall.
scenes.outgoing_state: Grounded, happy closure of the book.
